Sore shoulders after a press day is something I can't assess, and soreness that sits in a joint can be the kind of thing a doctor or physio should look at, not me. If it ever turns into pain, numbness or a joint that feels off, get that checked before you train it again.

Since you're asking what's on, I'll pull up your program and show you what's scheduled next. The program lookup came back empty, so I can't see what's scheduled yet. Tell me which session you're after, or check your Workouts tab for the next one, and we'll decide together whether it's a day to lean on the upper body or give it room.
